Date Nov. 20th., 1939.
Subject FRITZ WHITSAK - GERMAN EURASIAN EMPLOYED AS JAPANESE
INTELLIGENCE AGENT.
Made by D.S.I. Maklaevsky Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.I

DC Crime
Information
4/12?

P.A.
please show
to C.I.
Vice-Commr.
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 4 DEC 1939 (CRIME BRANCH)）
H.E.
5/12.
FILE
C 1/12

Information has been received from a very
reliable source to the effect that one Fritz Whitsak,
a German/Eurasian, owner of the East Asia Trading
Company, with offices at Hamilton House, Suit 331, is a
secret agent in the employ of the 2nd. Department of the
Headquarters of the Intelligence Service of the Japanese
Army in Central China.

Fritz Whitsak is about 40 years of age and an old
resident of Shanghai and was formerly engaged in arms
smuggling. He was at one time connected with a certain
Eickhoff, a well-known German arms smuggler. Besides
being an Intelligence Service agent, Whitsak is also
acting as a go-between in handling matters of " delicate "
nature on behalf of the Japanese and other interested
parties.

B. Maklaevsky -
D.S.I.

D.C. ( SPECIAL BRANCH ).

归档
C 1/12

据非常可靠的消息来源称，弗里茨·惠特萨克（Fritz Whitsak），一名德裔欧亚混血儿，东亚贸易公司（East Asia Trading Company）所有者，办公地点位于汉密尔顿大厦（Hamilton House）331室，是日本华中方面军司令部情报部第二课的 Secret Agent（秘密特工）。

弗里茨·惠特萨克年约四十岁，系上海老居民，从前从事武器走私活动。他曾与某位埃克霍夫（Eickhoff）有牵连，后者是一名知名的德国武器走私商。除了担任情报部门特工外，惠特萨克还充当中间人，代表日本及其他相关方处理“敏感”性质的事务。

B. 马克拉耶夫斯基 -
特别股督察长（D.S.I.）
